text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Summer also serves as a recovery period heading into the autumn season.
In other words, many people intentionally take time off.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why now is the time to train...!
Catch them off guard, close the gap, and pull far ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
Thinking about it really fires me up!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Let's both do our best. You for the Kikuka Sho, and me for next year's Triple Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ossu! Hip, hip, hooray-ssu!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Ei, ei, oh!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Ah, y-you'll really give it to me straight...?!
—Summer training camp went smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, it really is...!
This mountain path you looked up for me...
It's tough, but it feels so good to run on!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, did you try a new workout and end up sore?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: S-So that's why you're walking like that. Fufu, ahaha...!
choice_data_list: You don't have to laugh that much...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I'm sorry!
I'm just so happy...!
Hehe, I'm gonna give it my all during muscle training today!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Today it's either the "Chicken Breast & Broccoli Set" or the "Extra-Large Hamburg Steak"...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I wanna build muscle, but—
That Salisbury steak looks so good...
Can I really finish that whole portion, though...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Trainer, what do you think?
choice_data_list: Let's go with the Chicken Breast and Broccoli Set.
Let's go with the 'Jumbo Hamburger Steak'.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: “I see... Understood! Conditioning the body comes first after all, right!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... *munch*.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, no, huh? What? Huh? I-Is this...?!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: It's way too delicious...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're so right!
It's not about whether I *can* finish it, I *will* finish it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, thank you for the food!
Whoa, this looks delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch, munch, munch*! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch, munch, munch*...
*Munch*... *munch*...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, sir! I'm an Umamusume too,
after all, so something like this is... nngh!

...In the end, half was shared onto another plate,
and the two of them happily enjoyed it together.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san!
Over here!
Invited by Win Variation, we decided to go to a nearby fireworks festival.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to take up your time when you're busy.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
I see, that's such a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get going?
We've still got time before the fireworks... wanna grab something to eat?
That her roommate was apparently at the camp lodge too, that there was a flyer recruiting Bon Odori participants back at the dorm, and that there was supposedly a stall with delicious candy apples.

And so, while chatting about silly little things
and making our way through the stalls—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no way!
Isn't that totally super?"

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: Bari-yan?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation! You know,
she's always giving Orfevre a run for her money.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, one candy apple, please.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
Comiiing... Oh my?
Are you Win Variation?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching the Classic campaign!
I thought Orfevre would dominate completely this year,
but you're putting up a real fight. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Thank you so much...!
Here and there, people began to notice her presence.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's kinda... amazing.
I never thought so many people would start cheering for me."
choice_data_list: Your hard work is reaching them.
Your hard work is reaching people

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. I'm just doing what needs to be done,
and Trainer's—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I wanted to thank you for coming to the festival today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Umm, I'm pretty sure it's this way, but...
Mind coming along with me?

She seemed to have a destination in mind.
I followed behind Win Variation as she walked ahead.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...I honestly didn't think I'd make it this far in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I honestly thought it was gonna be way more painful.
I never imagined I'd have so many people cheering me on like this.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So... I've said it so many times you
might think I'm lying by now, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm truly grateful, really.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To you, it might really just
be doing your job, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You came up with training methods tailored just for me,
and on top of that, before races you'd encourage me
and pull me forward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's apple pie.
I borrowed the kitchen and baked it.
Um, if it's not a bother...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but since this alone isn't quite enough,
here's one more! It's about time—

As Win Variation looked up at the sky,
the faint glow of the fireballs reflected against her profile.
(Whistleee... BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's gorgeous, isn't it...!
Um, the training camp staff told me about this hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's all for the presents.
...Sorry it's nothing fancy, though.

The gift was great, but more than that,
I was just happy Win Variation wanted
to do something for me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Really? Th-Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...We've still got a long way to go from here.
I look forward to your continued guidance
and support!

As she bows so deeply in gratitude,
I reflexively bow my head in return.
choice_data_list: Same here, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.text:
As I replied with that,
something suddenly crossed my mind—

Have I really done enough
to deserve this much kindness?
She's grateful to me, but... all I'm doing is the bare minimum: planning training menus and encouraging her when she's feeling down.
"...It was her father who eased her nerves for her debut race, and Verxina who gave her energy without even realizing it by being someone who understood her."
Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

I hadn't become someone she could confide in,
and she hadn't talked to me about it since.
On the day the Twinkle Series began, I swore to myself that I would support her with everything I had as her Trainer, and yet...

"Perhaps I grew complacent with just supporting her training,
taking her silence for granted."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Another one!
It's so pretty...!
choice_data_list: (Is it really okay for me to stay like this?)
(Is it really okay for me to stay like this?)

text_block_list.text:
The apple pie package felt warm in my hands,
and the fireworks bloomed so brilliantly in the sky,
that such a thought couldn't help but cross my mind.
